verdict.rationale: Fastmail documents its JMAP API through a developer page, the IETF RFCs, and authenticated runtime session discovery. Nothing in the evidence shows an interactive API explorer or runnable in-browser examples. The probe found no OpenAPI/Swagger spec, and the dev page confirms the spec is the RFCs rather than an interactive reference, so static documentation is only an adjacent capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
